title: Orbital Station Life Support Stabilization - Mission 1
mission_description: Maintain life support integrity, balance thermal loops, and confirm bus stabilization across orbital eclipse dynamics.

subgoals.title: Activate CO2 Scrubber
subgoals.description: Engage primary life support scrubber to cycle cabin atmosphere

subgoals.title: Balance Thermal Coolant Loop A
subgoals.description: Transfer 5L coolant from reserve to loop A to maintain thermal equilibrium

subgoals.title: Reinforce Cabin Pressure
subgoals.description: Regulate life support nitrogen bleed to maintain cabin pressure >= 102.0 kPa

subgoals.title: Configure Solar Tracking
subgoals.description: Lock solar tracking mode to MAXIMUM_INSOLATION

subgoals.title: Confirm Station Life Support Stabilization
subgoals.description: Verify bus telemetry and emit station health stabilization clearance

title: Smart Industrial Microgrid Dispatch - Mission 11
mission_description: Balance generation and dynamic loads, preserve critical hospital power, and verify grid stability.

subgoals.title: Ramp Natural Gas Turbine
subgoals.description: Ramp gas turbine output to 140 kW to absorb upcoming industrial shift load

subgoals.title: Switch BESS to Peak Shaving
subgoals.description: Switch battery energy storage to peak shaving mode with net discharge

subgoals.title: Curtail Non-Critical Factory Load
subgoals.description: Apply 20% curtailment to secondary industrial feeders

subgoals.title: Lock Hospital Power Feeder
subgoals.description: Transfer critical hospital ward to dual-redundant bus feeder

subgoals.title: Certify Microgrid Stability
subgoals.description: Validate 50.0 Hz grid frequency and certify power balance

title: Autonomous Fleet Supply Chain Logistics - Mission 21
mission_description: Coordinate multi-hub payload transfers, preserve total inventory conservation, and maintain fleet battery integrity.

subgoals.title: Load Critical Medical Payload at Hub Alpha
subgoals.description: Load 4 inventory units from Hub Alpha into Drone Alpha 1

subgoals.title: Dispatch Drone Alpha 1 to Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Execute flight dispatch of Drone Alpha 1 along designated transit corridor

subgoals.title: Unload Payload at Hub Beta
subgoals.description: Unload 4 units into Hub Beta inventory, maintaining total fleet conservation

subgoals.title: Dock Drone Alpha 1 for Recharging
subgoals.description: Route Drone Alpha 1 to rapid charging bay

subgoals.title: Certify Fleet Manifest and Inventory Audit
subgoals.description: Execute fleet manifest reconciliation and certify total conserved inventory
